snippet.title: Sonic 06: Legacy of Solaris (Part 1) - Sonic's Story
snippet.description:
I decided to finally do this series due to reaching 300 subscribers, thank you! 

Check out the creator of this awesome mod here: 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4n7u8hA8DOoMnbDMb-4XSA

This is Sonic the Hedgehog on Xenia Emulator using the Legacy of Solaris Mod. The mod combined with Xenia makes a whole brand new experience when playing Sonic 06! This is part 1 of the playthrough so this video will be covering Sonic's Entire Story.
This entire playthrough will be very casual, as I'm just enjoying the changes made. After recording I noticed a quiet noise in the background that you can only hear really in loading screens and quiet story cutscenes. I hope it's not to distracting, I'll make sure to fix it by the next part!

Some quicks things you'll notice is there is less frame dips, so the cutscenes run at 60 fps which causes the mouths to sync up better. Along with some graphical changes. Loading screens are much faster. The mod changes to many things to list to unused content to cutting the forest trails. There's a alot of changes everywhere, but if you'd just like to see the stages here are the times.

Stages
Wave Ocean - 9:05
Dusty Desert - 19:15
White Acropolis - 35:07
Crisis City - 44:58
Flame Core - 53:49
Radical Train - 1:08:33
Tropical Jungle - 1:17:39
Kingdom Valley - 1:27:08
Aquatic Base - 1:38:04

Bosses 
Egg Cerberus - 16:23
Silver - 26:05
Iblis - 1:02:00
Egg Genesis - 1:14:15
Egg Wyvern  - 1:47:27
